command:
set -euo pipefail
echo CHROME_PROCESSES
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
for p in Path('/proc').glob('[0-9]*/cmdline'):
 try:
  s=p.read_bytes().replace(b'\0',b' ').decode(errors='replace')
 except: continue
 if 'chrome' in s.lower() and ('buehne' in s.lower() or 'remote-debugging' in s.lower() or '--app=' in s.lower()): print(p.parent.name,s[:1800])
PY
echo CDP_PORTS
for p in 9222 9223 9224 9225 9226 9230; do if curl -fsS --max-time 1 http://127.0.0.1:$p/json/version >/tmp/cdp.$p 2>/dev/null; then echo PORT=$p; cat /tmp/cdp.$p; fi; rm -f /tmp/cdp.$p; done
echo LIVE_HASHES
sha256sum buehne.html buehne_daemon.py filmlook.js
systemctl --user is-active frankenstein-buehne.service
